tts.voice_prompt: Warm, friendly cooking show host. Speak clearly and enthusiastically.

source.text: Today we're making a classic aglio e olio. You only need five ingredients and fifteen minutes.
Start by heating olive oil in a large pan. Add thinly sliced garlic and a pinch of red pepper flakes. Cook until the garlic is just golden.
Toss the pasta directly into the pan with a splash of pasta water. The starch creates a silky sauce that coats every strand.
